summary: Verified role-aware CRUD, clear mutation feedback, theme-aware login and refined receipt branding.
notes: Fixes item-edit authorization for Owner, Manager and Storekeeper roles with readable denial reasons.
Automatically closes transactional dialogs after successful saves, posts and printing.
Shows light-green success and red failure notifications with the underlying API reason.
Uses the selected theme on the login credential panel and adds the Beyond Raw Data signoff.
Prints Powered by Dukora | Beyond Raw Data in a smaller receipt footer font.
Adds a persistent Vertical or Horizontal menu layout setting.
Reflows and enlarges Sell-page item cards at Extra large display size.
Preserves the institution database outside the install directory and keeps 14 daily pre-start backups.
Automatically holds the first printed bill until it is posted as paid or credit.
Prints bold uppercase UNPAID, PAID or CREDIT status on browser and direct ESC/POS receipts.
Allows cashiers to add any active product while revising a held bill.
Fixes the database concurrency failure previously reported as a shared-server connection error.
Uses whole-unit sale quantities and prompts for customer registration before credit posting.
Adds live blinking attention counters and collapsible Operations and Data & Setup menus.
Projects seven-day stock risk from the latest 30 days of posted sales.
Adds an interactive notification center and detailed restock drill-down.
Lets owners and managers approve or reject sensitive held-bill edits from another terminal on the same institution server.
Adds an Excel-compatible bulk item template, file preview and row-level validation.
Separates stock units from package quantity and size for accurate product variants.
Supports whole-number discrete stock and measured quantities to three decimal places.
Adds explicit Skip, Update and Add Stock duplicate policies.
Records auditable import batches with dependency-safe Owner/Manager reversal.
Adds concise branded PDF reports with period KPIs, daily visuals and decision-ready tables.
Adds encrypted in-app AI provider settings while retaining deterministic offline insights.
Corrects SQLite live-date queries and payment-period calculations used by dashboards and reports.
Prints and holds unpaid bills without prematurely changing revenue or stock.
Posts paid and credit sales atomically with stock, payment, profit and audit updates.
Supports later partial/full payments, controlled refunds and immutable bill revisions.
Adds interactive live bill follow-up, dashboard drill-downs and menu attention indicators.
Adds audited item, customer and staff editing with safe archival instead of destructive deletion.
Adds full-screen POS mode and a smaller scrollable sidebar that keeps every menu accessible.
Adds Compact, Standard, Large and Extra large display presets.
Scales and reflows the whole UI so cards, charts and touch controls retain their proportions.
Persists the selected size on each POS terminal and applies it before the UI renders.
Runs the optional Xprinter vendor setup during Dukora's elevated installation stage.
Adds a Start-menu repair action that explicitly requests Windows administrator approval.
Bundles Microsoft's full offline x64 Evergreen WebView2 runtime.
Records the exact embedded-view initialization failure in the local desktop log.
Keeps Dukora running and opens the same local UI in the default browser as a fallback.
Uses the same React UI, API, reports, visualizations and business rules as Dukora Server.
Stores data locally in SQLite with WAL journaling and no PostgreSQL installation.
Opens in a branded touch-friendly WebView2 desktop window.
Starts and stops the local API and XP-80 print bridge with the desktop application.
Protects the first-run Owner PIN with Windows DPAPI.
Includes the official Microsoft WebView2 bootstrapper and optional Xprinter driver.
